description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'Authorize' controller class within the OpenCart project, specifically for the 'account' namespace. It manages user authorization actions such as index page rendering, sending authorization tokens, validation, unlocking, confirming, resetting, and unlocking account authorizations.
published: Opencart ody ody ody ody ody

classes.name: Authorize
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling account authorization-related actions such as login authorization, sending authorization tokens, validation, unlocking, confirming, resetting, and unlocking account status.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the authorization page, setting language strings, handling cookies for authorization tokens, and preparing data for the view.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to send an authorization email, includes setting success message and headers.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the authorization token, checks attempts, manages authorization data, and redirects appropriately.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks authorization for a user if certain conditions are met, resets attempts, and redirects.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms an authorization reset request, verifies codes, resets authorization status, and manages session data.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets authorization code and manages redirection based on email and code inputs.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the user account authorization, typically after multiple failed attempts.
